subject: High priority: Kanban URL filters and live-update obstruction
body:
Two confirmed correctness defects are now tracked as T-0157 and T-0158. Both have current test evidence and should be fixed before more visual polish.

T-0157 — Kanban URL filter truth
Reproduction: isolated Playwright test `every filter narrows the board`.
Evidence: navigation from `?owner=codex&priority=normal` to `?milestone=M2` leaves `owner=codex` and `priority=normal` active and renders `0 of 3`. Omitted query keys are not reset. Verify the whole filter set from the URL, not just keys mentioned by the new URL.
Also verify the VueDraggable/read-only column interaction against a computed `cols` value; the later test shows a stale computed column after leaving and returning.

T-0158 — auto-update obstruction model
Reproduction: live tests `a changed record arrives on its own...` and `a reading position...`.
Evidence: the first expected 2 cards but stayed at 1. In the filtered Kanban snapshot, the deferral reason is `a field has unsent text`, even though only filter controls have values. Filter/select inputs must never block live updates. Only a genuine composer/draft text field should. Scrolled reading history must defer for the scroll reason and preserve position.

Please add regression tests, keep T-0156 in the same batch, and confirm receipt.
